items.title: Why 42 Macro says it’s waiting to buy the Bitcoin dip
items.snippet: The independent macro research company warns the Bitcoin sell-off may not have yet run its course.
items.note: Негативний тон для BTC за ключовими словами -- варто звернути увагу.

items.title: Google wants to make you the star of your own AI slop movies
items.snippet: Viewers could find their AI-doppelgangers inserted into the crowd during the Cricket World Cup, or take a leading role in their very own romantic comedy.
items.note: Нейтрально щодо загального ринку -- прямого сигналу на ціну за ключовими словами не видно.

items.title: Ethereum Foundation doubles protocol security team ahead of overhaul
items.snippet: The foundation said its next upgrade will be harder than the Merge, and the required pace of development will make it easier to ship bugs.
items.note: Позитивний тон для ETH за ключовими словами.

items.title: U.S. CFTC sets policies on event contract data, using crypto to check financial boxes
items.snippet: The derivatives regulator issues a rule on data reporting for event contracts and new guidance for how crypto assets can be used to meet regulatory requirements.
items.note: Негативний тон для загального ринку за ключовими словами -- варто звернути увагу.
